source: What Makes Good Data for Training Coding Agents? A Systematic Study on SWE-Gym

source_revision.license: Apache-2.0 repository additions; upstream benchmark terms remain source-specific

chronology: retrospective task-level analysis reconstructed after publication

endpoint.definition: Mean task pass rate across three trained seeds decreases by at least 25 percentage points from the common starting policy.

evaluation.target_shift: SWE-bench Pro changes repository family, language coverage, scaffold budget, and evaluation contract relative to the Python SWE-Gym training source.

claim_boundary: the four environments and both targets are nested under one released training study
task pass rates use finite repeated attempts and the 25-point endpoint remains a descriptive threshold
the analysis transfers across repositories within the released study, not across trainers or model families
the model was reconstructed after publication and is not a prospective coding regression forecast
